title: alyssum minus var. collinum
intro: Alyssum minus var. collinum, commonly known as Sweet Alyssum, is a low-growing, flowering perennial plant that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of depression. The therapeutic actions of Sweet Alyssum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils that possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Sweet Alyssum may also contribute to its potential use in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions.
